messages.author: 6610994aa1e0510f
messages.subject: Issue with mesh construction
parts:
Hello INLA community,

I am attempting to create a mesh triangulation as the first steps of my modelling.

However, I cannot seem to run this code: 

mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(
  loc = coo, max.edge = c(10, 50),
  cutoff = 5
)

It runs for more than 10 mins then crashes my R. I am using the most updated version of INLA "INLA_24.06.27" and using R version 4.4.0 (2024-04-24). This seems to be a recent issue, as I was able to compute this code about 1 month ago. Has anyone encountered this issue?

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Issue with mesh construction
parts:
Hi,
THE inla version is mostly irrelevant for this, as it just calls the fmesher fm_mesh_2d_inla() function.
What’s your fmesher version, and str(coo) output?
Finn
